rows: One row per change between consecutive snapshots in our own daily captures.

columns.name: program
columns.meaning: The program's ID. anthropic-cvd for every row today.

columns.name: capture_utc
columns.meaning: When we first captured the newer snapshot (its ledger.json fetch time).
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: event_type
columns.meaning: new_commitment, removed_commitment, revealed, withdrawn, merged, status_change, headline_change or field_change.
columns.label: Independently verified

columns.name: hash_or_finding_id
columns.meaning: The finding ID when revealed, otherwise the hash. Empty for headline_change.

columns.name: field
columns.meaning: The published name of the field that changed (for example status, tier, model_severity, or a snapshots column for headline_change). Empty for new_commitment and removed_commitment.

columns.name: old_value
columns.meaning: Value in the earlier snapshot (empty for none).
columns.label: Lab-reported

columns.name: new_value
columns.meaning: Value in the newer snapshot (empty for none).
columns.label: Lab-reported
